#### A result cited rather than derived

The next theorem is cited, not derived.
Its derivation needs a formula for how the inverse of the
[cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix) $A$
changes when one observation's outer product $\soprod{\vxi}$ is removed from it
(the Sherman--Morrison formula),
which this page does not develop.

:::
